name: InfiniteTalk Image-to-Video (lip-sync)
description: Audio-driven talking-head. Animates a still image to lip-sync a voice line (Wan 2.1 I2V backbone + InfiniteTalk/MultiTalk). Talking-head motion only, not big body motion.

prompt.description: Drives expression/motion. InfiniteTalk is talking-head; keep it simple.

image.description: Input image filename (staged to ComfyUI input).

audio.description: Input audio filename (wav) staged to ComfyUI input. Drives lip-sync + clip length.

negative_prompt.default: bright tones, overexposed, static, blurred details, subtitles, style, works, paintings, images, static, overall gray, worst quality, low quality, JPEG compression residue, ugly, incomplete, extra fingers, poorly drawn hands, poorly drawn faces, deformed, disfigured, misshapen limbs, fused fingers, still picture, messy background, three legs, many people in the background, walking backwards

width.description: Resize target width (divisible by 16). Kijai's example: 640, center crop.

height.description: Resize target height (divisible by 16). Kijai's example: 640, center crop.

length.description: Cap on output frames (num_frames into MultiTalkWav2VecEmbeds), not an exact length: the node clamps to the audio, so the voice line sets the real length. 400 is Kijai's example_03 value.

fps.description: InfiniteTalk is trained at 25fps; do not change unless you know why.

steps.description: Sampler steps. 6 with the lightx2v speed LoRA is the tuned default.

blocks_to_swap.description: Transformer blocks kept in system RAM instead of VRAM. 20 is Kijai's example_03 value.

model.description: GGUF-quantized Wan2.1 I2V 14B backbone (~7.9GB). Fits 12GB card with block-swap. fp8 safetensors OOMs a 12GB card.

multitalk_model.description: GGUF-quantized InfiniteTalk module (~1.3GB). Must be GGUF to pair with the GGUF backbone.
